adjudication.rationale: In `spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb`, the `"cannot remove members from automatic groups"` example calls `xhr :put, :remove_member, group_id: 1, user_id: 42`, but the diff wires `remove_member` to the DELETE verb (`config/routes.rb`: `delete "members" => "groups#remove_member"`). So the spec is not exercising the intended DELETE route. Additionally, hardcoding `group_id: 1` assumes an automatic group with id 1 exists, which is implicit fixture/seed coupling rather than setting up the needed automatic group in the test.
